findings.message: Global setup mutates shared state: `execSync("npx prisma migrate deploy"…`.
findings.why: Migrations/seeds/deletes against a shared environment break every other pipeline and developer pointing at it — and the damage happens before any test runs.
findings.fix: Target an ephemeral per-run environment (testcontainers, branch DB) instead of shared infrastructure.
